6333.title: System notices bypass the active-compaction queue
6333.rootCauseOneLine: Parent system-notice dispatch checks pending interactions but not manual compaction, so an accepted compaction receives an auto-targeted turn submission instead of a queued notice.
6333.proposedFix: Use the existing isManualCompactionActive predicate before immediate parent-system delivery, retaining the existing durable queue and system-notice taxonomy.
6333.caveats: Reproduced at the real server/SQLite dispatch boundary using the repository host-RPC responder. No live Codex process, UI error, notification-loss outcome, or automation disablement was exercised. Before provider acceptance, the existing turn-starting queue already works.
